title: Company launch
summary: Incorporate, get the EIN, put the founders and cap table on paper, open the bank account, turn on payroll and the books.

parts.title: Incorporate C-Corp
parts.guidance: Confirm the intended jurisdiction and entity form before entering the incorporation workflow. Keep the selected formation service, filing details and founder decisions together, then collect the authority's completed formation record. Carry the exact legal identity into the remaining launch work, while tracking any unfinished organizational or founder-stock documents separately from incorporation itself.

parts.title: Get EIN
parts.guidance: Use the formed entity's exact legal identity and responsible-party details to prepare the tax-identification application for the applicable jurisdiction. Follow the EIN workflow only where a US EIN is appropriate and obtain the authorized applicant's approval before submission. Use the issued notice as the source for banking and payroll setup, and store it with restricted access.

parts.title: Set up cap table
parts.guidance: Assemble the formation documents, authorized share structure and approved founder equity arrangements before setting up ownership records. Reconcile the cap table to the underlying signed and completed transactions. Record authorized shares, proposed allocations and completed issuances separately, with the documents supporting each completed transaction.

parts.title: Sign the founder agreement & split equity
parts.guidance: Resolve the founders' proposed roles, contributions, ownership, vesting and departure arrangements through the founder-agreement workflow. Have counsel and the authorized founders review the actual documents before signature. Carry the executed agreement into the company's records and assign the remaining equity and operating actions needed to implement its terms.

parts.title: Open bank account
parts.guidance: Use the filed entity name and identification records to assemble the bank's requested application, ownership details and authorized signers. Resolve account access and payment controls with the people who will operate them. Follow the account-opening process through the bank's decision and confirmed account details, then use those details for the company's intended payments and collections.

parts.title: Set up payroll
parts.guidance: Decide whether payroll setup is needed for the company's actual employees, work locations and intended first pay date. Use the payroll-setup workflow to collect approved employment and tax details, configure access and funding, and validate the first run. Keep setup completion separate from payroll release, which needs approval for the specific people, period and amounts.

parts.title: Set up accounting
parts.guidance: Set up the books for the entity, reporting currency and financial year, bringing in formation costs, bank activity and completed founder funding. Reconcile opening balances against their supporting records and separate uncertain classifications for the accountant. Leave a usable chart of accounts and a clear owner for the first close.
